name: gamenet_show_player_kill_message
description: GameNet::ShowPlayerKillMessage formats a multiplayer kill-feed line from victim, kill verb, and killer names and forwards it to the HUD top-message stack.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the GameNet packet/HUD message cluster so CRT formatting and HUD stack call shape can be compared coherently.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x414330 validates choosing killEntry->killVerbString when present, falling back to zLoc::GetMessageString(0x253) for a null kill entry, formatting "%s %s %s" into a 0x50-byte stack buffer from victim and killer display names, and forwarding the result to HudUi::ShowTopMessageLine with a 2.0 second duration.
The native smoke verifies kill-entry verb formatting through GameNet::ShowPlayerKillMessage and the HUD top-message stack side effect used by packet-08 handling.
